name: Tumerok Fort (10.3N, 68.8W)
title: 10.3N, 68.8W - Tumerok Fort
summary: A Tumerok fort (three loot chests in the tower per acpedia) that fills the floor of a narrow north-south rock valley (z 102) in the Dires. Flat-roofed halls with stake palisades form a 50 x 75 m block, with a 31 m spire tower at its north-east corner (barrels on its platform). The valley walls rise 12-20 m to the west and 30-50 m to the east, and the valley opens to a flat at its south end.
